name: Giant Manufacturing Co., Ltd. (Giant Group)
note: Taiwanese bicycle maker; its corporate site giantgroup-cycling.com is headed 'Giant Group (TPE: 9921)' and lists Giant, Liv, momentum and CADEX as its product brands (page opened 2026-10-03). In September 2025 US Customs and Border Protection issued a Withhold Release Order against its Taiwan-made bicycles, parts and accessories on information that reasonably indicates forced labour (claim giant-manufacturing-wro-2025); a maintainer decides whether that counts as a finding.
